method.displayedHeat: contactEvents + obstacleBlockedEvents; crowd waiting, traffic and dwell time excluded
method.contacts: attempted obstacle overlap, 1 second per agent debounce
method.blocked: unreachable target or 3.5 seconds sustained stall, one event per trip
method.cellDiagnostics: aggregate retained per cell; last 8 detailed events per cell
method.limitations: Single horizontal floor, conservative 0.08–1.8m projection, not a standards compliance check
